WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        y.Date,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
        COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM 
        customers c
        JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment, y.Date
),
least_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        s.Segment,
        MIN(s.total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM 
        segment_consumption s
    GROUP BY 
        s.Segment
)
SELECT 
    l.Segment,
    (SELECT AVG(total_consumption) 
     FROM segment_consumption 
     WHERE Segment = l.Segment AND total_consumption = l.min_consumption) AS avg_min_consumption
FROM 
    least_consumption l
ORDER BY 
    l.Segment
